name: SL-M980-A control pair
weight_description: Calculated pair weight: 104 g (SL-M980-A-L) + 99 g (SL-M980-A-R) = 203 g, using Shimano’s published individual-unit average weights. Band clamp controls for 10-speed rear shifting and selectable 2/3-chainring front shifting, without optical gear displays. Cable/housing inclusion is not specified. This revision is distinct from the original SL-M980.
